summary: Full frontend E2E testing of the AI Watermark Remover (client-side canvas engine). All 9 requested feature checks passed: landing page brand, header (no GitHub/Chrome Extension UI), 16-chip AI tool selector with mode text updates, Gemini exact removal on synthetic star image -> detection-badge-exact, adaptive removal on Sora-selected image -> detection-badge-adaptive, plain image in Auto -> detection-badge-none, batch upload of 2 images with ZIP download 'ai-watermark-removed.zip', per-item PNG download ('gemini_test-clean.png'), remove-item + clear-all, and /video route showing 'AI Video Watermark Remover'. No console/page errors observed during any processing.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: the substring 'github' appears inside the bundled JSZip library (build/static/js/main.*.js) — this is 3rd-party library internal code, not visible UI. All user-facing GitHub/Chrome Extension entry points are correctly removed from Header, Footer, and Final CTA. No action required.
seed_data_creation: Generated 3 synthetic PNGs in /tmp/wm_tests via PIL: gemini_test.png (1024x1024 gradient + semi-transparent 4-pointed white star at bottom-right ~32px margin), adaptive_test.png (800x600 gradient + semi-transparent white rounded rect/circles in bottom-left), plain_test.png (800x600 pure gradient, no watermark).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test PNGs at /tmp/wm_tests/. Playwright set_input_files works directly with input[data-testid='file-input'] despite it being hidden. Gemini exact detection triggered on the synthetic star (Pearson corr > 0.32 threshold met). All detection badges (exact/adaptive/none) render correctly. Console error handler was active during processing and no errors were emitted.
